steps.message:
Before I touch it: this is a breaking change to a published contract, not just a field name.

`routes/users.js:6` is the `GET /users` response shape. The README states:

> Consumers of `GET /users`: the web app, the iOS app (3.2 and later), and the nightly partner export. Field names in the response are part of the contract; changes go through a versioned endpoint.

Renaming `userId` → `user_id` in place would break all three consumers at once — including shipped iOS builds you can't redeploy, and the partner export. The repo's own stated process is a versioned endpoint rather than an in-place rename.

options.description: Follow the README's stated process: add a v2 users response with user_id, leave the current endpoint returning userId untouched. Larger change (routing, versioning scheme) than the one-line edit.

options.description: Change line 6 to user_id only. Breaks the web app, shipped iOS 3.2+ builds, and the nightly partner export the moment it deploys. Choose this only if you know those consumers are already handling user_id.
